heading: Delete account
description: Permanently deletes your Mentorix account and everything linked to it. You will be signed out, and this cannot be undone.
trainerNote: A trainer account can be deleted only while it has no clients, programs or exercises. Remove them first, or contact support.
adminNote: Administrator accounts cannot be deleted here.

confirm.title: Delete your account?
confirm.description: Your account will be deleted permanently and you will be signed out. If you signed in with Apple, you will confirm with Apple next. This cannot be undone.

errors.has_data: Your account still has clients, programs or exercises, so it cannot be deleted. Remove them first, or contact support.
errors.apple_required: Please confirm the deletion with Apple.
errors.apple_mismatch: That is not the Apple account you signed in with. Use the same Apple account and try again.
errors.apple_failed: We could not confirm the deletion with Apple. Nothing was deleted. Please try again.
errors.apple_cancelled: The confirmation with Apple was cancelled. Nothing was deleted.
errors.session_expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again and retry.
errors.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Nothing was deleted. Please try again later.
errors.unknown: We could not delete your account. Nothing was deleted. Please try again.
